key_findings: Shop route selection cannot explain the majority of failure: 6/8 contexts keep Shop route 0 at step 144; only seed 70291004 selects route 6, and all force route 2 at step 648.

The first persistent divergence occurs at step 65, before route selection: P0 strands 4 fertilizer in worker cargo and cannot finance the declared cow, while Shop realizes the same fertilizer and funds the cow.
P0 broadly under-completes its own declared tours: about 76.5-77.1% aggregate completion, 396-407 missed day obligations, and 375-389 cumulative carry-over by day 28.
Whole-game production is broadly lower even in route-0 contexts: wheat about 262 vs 517, strawberries 77-85 vs 249, melon 6 vs 72, with lower animal harvests as well.
Public market trajectories diverge materially later, especially under route-3/12 opponents, but service/financing failure starts before those market regimes separate.

No small programme-level diagnostic generalizes: +1-day animal deferral median gap recovery 6.65%; +1 daily hire median -17.43%; completed-tour capital realization is mixed and far below the >=50% multi-context salvage threshold.
